name: diorama-monorepo
description: Diorama (codename): a React Native 2.5D game-map library.

scripts.build: npm run build:protocol && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:protocol && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:protocol && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.docs:dev: node docs/scripts/ensure-deps.mjs && npm --prefix docs run dev
scripts.docs:build: node docs/scripts/ensure-deps.mjs && npm --prefix docs run build
